title: Olivia Rodrigo & Dan Nigro: expectations
sub: Olivia Rodrigo brought her producer Dan Nigro onto the station her fans run to go through expectations. 4,990 people came and 1,618 of them chatted. In these forty five seconds Dan answers a fan who asked what the effect on her vocal in the bridge is, and tells them there isn't one.

title: Kylie Cantrall
sub: Kylie Cantrall put her single on in her own listening party and the room went line for line with it. A channel of 4,390, and 49 of them typing inside twenty seven seconds.

title: The Warning
sub: The Warning asked their listening party where they were tuning in from. The answers came back from 152 people inside twenty six seconds, on a channel of 24,000.

title: Olivia Rodrigo
sub: Olivia Rodrigo gave her fans’ station ten minutes and read their names out loud. In one forty five second stretch, twenty eight of them bought the record. The room stayed another fifty minutes and did most of the show’s streaming after she had gone.

title: EJAE
sub: EJAE picked up the mic on LE SSERAFIM’s show, in front of a channel of 148,769. The replies came back in Korean and English at once, from people who were awake at three in the morning to be there.

title: ADÉLA
sub: ADÉLA dropped out of her own listening party and came back. The first thing the room did was tell her they could hear her. A channel of 1,878 members, and 226 of them streaming through the show.

title: INOHA
sub: INOHA ran their own listening party for a channel of 552 members. The room egged them on and somebody asked for a clip. Nothing about the format needs a big audience to work.

title: Trueblood
sub: Trueblood ran an EP release off their own station with no channel behind it. 1,322 people came. Here the band stops to say thank you and the room will not let them finish.

title: Number_i
sub: Number_i’s listening party ran to a channel of 816,738. Inside forty five seconds, 618 different people posted. It is the widest spread of any moment here.

title: Victoria Monét
sub: Victoria Monét was booked for fifteen minutes on a station her fans run and stayed on the mic for forty four. 197 people streamed the record 3,794 times while she was there, about nineteen plays each. This is the part where she asks to do it again.

title: King & Prince
sub: King & Prince ran a party for their SoHoney EP on Tiara. 13,105 people came, and in twenty five minutes on air the record was streamed 22,224 times, with 683 of them typing inside forty five seconds.
